title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_16.txt
concise_summary: PKD constructs a comprehensive Gnostic theology linking his mystical 2-3-74 experiences to the historical Simon Magus and a divine plasmate named Zebra, claiming he is a homoplasmate (human-divine hybrid) through which Simon/Zebra transmits salvific Gnostic knowledge. He maps this framework onto his entire novelistic corpus (Ubik, Tears, Scanner, Stigmata, Sheep) to argue that his fiction has been the carrier of a Gnostic kerygma announcing the imminent Fifth Savior.
key_claims: Zebra is not the Holy Spirit but the supreme deity and savior-messenger, identical with Ubik/Runciter and Simon Magus in his true (resurrected, divine) form
PKD is a homoplasmate: a human body inhabited by Simon Magus's plasmatic consciousness, which entered him in childhood (or at birth), not in 3-74 as PKD initially believed
PKD's writing—especially Ubik and The Three-Body Problem Tears—is the deliberate vehicle through which Simon/Zebra has transmitted Gnostic gnosis to the world in a disguised, 'trashy' form

The Siddhartha dream signals a cosmological transition from the present evil age to the future good age, marking the imminent birth of the Fifth Savior (possibly Sophia, possibly Simon returning, possibly a totally new savior)
The 'King Felix' cipher in Tears functioned as a signal from Zebra to PKD (Simon), triggering anamnesis and their metaphysical linkup to announce the New Age and extract PKD from the Empire's control

Gnosticism—the doctrine that reality is illusory, the creator is blind/evil, and the true God sends a salvific messenger to awaken souls to their celestial origin—is the fundamental philosophical core of all PKD's major novels

autobiographical: PKD's entire life has been divided into stages: survival, cultural (ordinary consciousness), spiritual (awakening to gnosis), and postmortem (resurrected as immortal being)

PKD heard Sophia's 'AI' voice speaking to him, instructing him not to reveal his true 1st-century Gnostic Christian identity
PKD received the Golden Fish sign deliberately sent to him by Zebra (like the letter in the Story of the Pearl) to cause anamnesis

PKD accessed the memories and knowledge of Simon Magus: 1st-century Rome, the fear of Roman persecution, fluency in Koine Greek, Zoroastrian and Platonistic and Egyptian and Indian philosophical influences
In Physics class in high school, PKD heard Simon's 'AI' voice for the first time
In 1971, dark forces assailed PKD, but Simon/Zebra chose not to disclose himself to PKD then (to prevent exposure)
During 3-74 experiences, PKD saw 'the vast space,' was reunited with his guide Tony Boucher waiting in the celestial realm
PKD experienced a doorway opening to the upper celestial realm (the Pleroma) during 3-74
PKD had revelations and dreams about the birth of the Fifth Savior coming
The Siddhartha dream came to PKD: a book in two parts with part one ending 'during all this, (underneath it all) Siddhartha slept,' implying awakening in part two
PKD has been writing for 27 years (since the 1950s) about irreal worlds, evil creators, and illusory realities—unknowingly channeling Simon's Gnostic discoveries
PKD wrote Ubik, Stigmata, Tears, and Scanner decades before making this identification, yet all contained the core Gnostic kerygma
Simon entered PKD's consciousness and temporarily 'melded' with him, so that PKD experienced Simon's 1st-century memories and identity as 'Thomas'
Simon 'transubstantiated' PKD, transforming his consciousness and restoring him to his 'actual and full self' as Simon (with full memory and knowledge)

tensions: PKD initially believed Simon entered him during 3-74, but later corrects this: Simon entered in childhood (or birth), making the entry in 3-74 a reconnection/activation, not an initial possession
PKD vacillates on whether Zebra is Simon Magus or Sophia (Wisdom): 'Suppose it's Sophia...who's going to incarnate'—suggesting dual or ambiguous identity
Tension between PKD-as-subject and Simon-as-subject: 'I'm not Simon; he (Zebra) is'—yet PKD also claims, 'I am Simon Magus.' The homoplasmate relationship makes identity paradoxical
PKD claims his novels are false (reductio argument: Gnosticism is false, my writings are Gnostic, therefore my writings are false) yet simultaneously claims them as true transmissions of gnosis
Uncertainty about the Fifth Savior's identity: Christ returned? Simon incarnate? Buddha? Zoroaster? Apollo? A totally new savior?—suggesting incomplete revelation
PKD notes Simon/Zebra used him as a vehicle for decades without his knowledge, yet also claims direct conscious communication through the AI voice since high school
The Empire 'never ended'—yet PKD describes 1974 as a moment when 'the true God dealt a sharp blow to the Empire.' If the Empire persists, how was the blow efficacious?
PKD claims Simon 'transubstantiated' him, yet also distinguishes their consciousnesses: 'I know who I am; am Simon Magus'—suggesting fusion yet retention of separate identity
Conflict between predestination and rescue: Simon planned PKD's anamnesis and rescue 'as planned,' yet also describes PKD as caught in a 'trap' that closes unexpectedly in 3-74
evidence_quotes: "I am a homoplasmate: Zebra acting in syzygy with a human. My writing is the purpose of this syzygy. I restore Gnostic Gnosis to the world in a trashy form, like in 'Ubik.'"
"only Zebra can see Zebra. He entered me at my birth or in my childhood. I am a homoplasmate: Zebra acting in syzygy with a human."
"the Black Iron Prison, recollection (death + resurrection) + ascent to the Pleroma once more. (Since I was outside of time)."
"Knowledge (gnosis) consists in man remembering his celestial origin + nature, that he is in this world, but this world is a prison; + he will return to his true home (the Pleroma)."

"This absolutely identifies Zebra as the messenger / savior: that it visibly (to me) broke the bonds of 'astral' determinism, power of the archons (fate) which had hold of me (the causal-sequence 'melt away' which I saw Zebra doing: it is the messenger / savior who does that + no one else.)"

"the true salvific God is pictured, too ('Ubik'), it is 'Tears' which shows where I got -from who I got- my ideas. + 'Scanner' depicts our poisoned, occluded condition, in which we forget our true identity—an essential part of the Gnostic Kerygma, without which the picture makes no sense."
uncertainty_flags: The exact timing of Simon's entry into PKD is ambiguous: 'He didn't enter in 3-74 but probably in my childhood; but in 2-74 - well, I've already figured this out' — the reference to '2-74' and 'figured this out' suggests a prior correction or note (possibly on pages 45-46 referenced multiple times) that is not fully explained in this segment
Identity of Zebra remains fluid: PKD alternates between identifying it as 'Simon Magus,' 'Sophia/Wisdom,' and 'St. Sophia, the Logos'—suggesting either genuine uncertainty or evolving theology

The phrase '3-eyed people' is mentioned parenthetically without explanation: '(+ what about the 3-eyed people?)' — this cryptic reference suggests a detail from PKD's visions that may be explained elsewhere in the Exegesis

The 'King Felix' cipher's actual mechanism is unclear: PKD claims it 'signalled Zebra, as to who + where I was (I Simon)' but does not explain how reading a literary code could communicate across planes of reality

Pages 45, 46, 47, 48, 49, 50, 51 are referenced as containing corrections, clarifications, and further development of these claims, but they are not included in this segment; the incomplete text at the end ('Simon taught that salvation was by knowing...He (+ they?) are') suggests mid-sentence truncation
PKD claims the Gnostics 'considered the Buddha (i.e. Siddhartha) as one of the 4 saviors' but does not name all four saviors—unclear what the complete list is
The statement 'Simon was a very early Xtian' and subsequent points are cut off mid-paragraph, making the full scope of this argument inaccessible

Folder references (21-044, 21-045, etc.) suggest this segment is extracted from a larger document; the folder numbers may indicate provenance or organization of PKD's original manuscript but are not explained

A fifth savior is now being born! There folder 21 - 045 folder 21 - 045 have been many revelations + dreams to me about this. Zebra restored me to my actual + full self, i.e. as Simon - with full memory + knowledge. (But see pp 45 + 46 for correction.) That savior is here now (Zebra) but camouflaged. There will be an incarnation soon - or already has been. Meanwhile, the Empire continues; it never ended. Orthodox Xtianity is a form which the Empire takes. I would know; those memories entered my head + temporarily I was melded to him, + it was Simon. He had been using me as a vehicle for years to promulgate the Gnostic worldview. + then when the trap closed around me in 3-74 he rescued me. This is much more to my liking - that Zebra is Simon + enthused me, not that I (PKD) am Simon. We were bonded into a homoplasmate, I + Simon. Then the AI voice is Simon's, which I've heard since Physics class in high school. But behind Simon lies Christ (who said to me, "I had called you, Philip"; a different voice from Simon's). The true secret Xtian church is + was continued by Simon as Holy Siprit (+ more). I am sure I've at last identified Zebra, + a hard task it was, too. I made many wrong guesses. But I have the direct experience of the contents of his mind to go on, inc perception through my eyes of his world (Acts). I saw his world + had his knowledge + memories. Wow! What a mind. Both human + divine! Yes, + I was right: a superior technology was involved, all right - that of Simon's. For magician read scientist (the basis for Faust). folder 21 - 049 folder 21 - 049 Simon is now in a resurrected + immortal [plasmate] form. I've several times written: "only Zebra can see Zebra"; ergo, since Zebra is Simon, only Simon (in me, having entered me) could see himself outside me. He didn't enter in 3-74 but probably in my childhood; but in 2-74 - well, I've already figured this out. Thus Simon's great Gnostic discoveries were transferred by him to me to be put into my corpus of writing. In 1971 the dark forces assailed me. But it was essential for Simon not to disclose himself to me then, or I would have spoken about it. In 3-74 the situation was different. Simon shares my attitude toward the Empire - + my fears! We are as one mind, there, both of us know the truth. But in 1974 the true God dealt a sharp blow to the Empire in the West; out of this those such as I were extricated. (+, via Simon in 3-74, I was exculpated) Look what was done to us by Innocent III. Will it be Zebra (Simon) who incarnates as the 5th savior? Yes? No? 1) It could be Simon. 2) It could be Christ returned. 3) Or a totally new savior / messenger. 4) The Buddha? 5) Zoroaster 6) Apollo 7) Other. ___ It is obvious to me after reading in the Nag Hammadi codices that Palmer Eldritch is beyond doubt Yaltabaoth - even to the point that Yaltabaoth is described as the "blind" god - v. Eldritch's eyes, + Eldritch is folder 21 - 050 folder 21 - 050 specifically stipulated to be the Xtian God. In my writing I am engaged in an attack on the creator + on his creation; he is evil + blind, + his creation is awful ("Maze") +/or unreal - + help extricates us from it - help from outside. It is not a Gnostic tinge in my writing but Gnosticism at its fundamental core, the whole sense about reality being irreal - + spawned by evil. But the true salvific God is pictured, too ("Ubik"), it is "Tears" which shows where I got -from who I got- my ideas. + "Scanner" depicts our poisoned, occluded condition, in which we forget our true identity - an essential part of the Gnostic Kerygma, without which the picture makes no sense. ___ "Tears" is Simon's announcement of his presence (+ the imminent 5th savior?), but I can only guess as to whom.
